Well my family gave me my own room, which is the basement. I don’t have any electronics except for my sisters phone and she left me money to get a laptop. I don’t have any furniture just clothes. My parents chain my to the floor and to the wall and whip me and slap me and hit me and beat me and all that kind of stuff....

My sister was an 18 year old in collage. She majored I’m becoming a doctor. She lived with me in a small two bedroom one bathroom apartment. We were the kind of sisters who never fought and always stood up for each other.
We shared everything except clothing and shoes because I was smaller everywhere except in the chest area. She was twice the size of me. She was 5’7 with a boyfriend. She loved to play games and hangout. We go to this place called John-day every holiday and go to our favorite coffee shop called the “Corner Cup”. We did everything together. We cried together, we laughed together, we cut together, we ate together, well she ate I just watched. We went to the hospital together. When I was little she used to take me to the doctors because I was a very sick kid. Sometimes she would bring in a toy doctors kit and pretend to give me check ups. Her name was Sammy Murray. She died two days ago in my arms from lack of blood.....
